extract_weight_from_fx_node: extract weight tensor from an FX graph node for call_module or call_function operations
build_weight_extraction_mapping: build a mapping of op types and module types to their weight extraction functions for FX graph analysis
get_conv_mod_weight: get weight tensor from a convolution module handling Conv1d, Conv2d, Conv3d and ConvReLU intrinsic variants
get_linear_mod_weight: get weight tensor from a linear module handling Linear, LinearReLU and quantized variants
get_lstm_mod_weights: get list of LSTM weight tensors for input-hidden and hidden-hidden weights from standard or quantized LSTM modules
